title: Notes CRUD API
description: Build a complete CRUD API for managing notes with in-memory storage.

steps.title: List all notes
steps.description: Create a GET /notes endpoint that returns an array of notes. Start with an empty array.
hints: Initialize an empty array in memory
Use app.get('/notes', handler) to respond with the array

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

notes = []

@app.get('/notes')
def list_notes():
    return notes

steps.title: Create a note
steps.description: Add a POST /notes endpoint that accepts JSON body with "title" and "content", creates a note with a unique id, and returns 201 status.
hints: Read body with req.body and assign an auto-increment id

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class NoteIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    content: str

class Note(NoteIn):
    id: int

notes = []
next_id = 1

@app.get('/notes')
def list_notes():
    return notes

@app.post('/notes', status_code=201)
def create_note(note: NoteIn):
    global next_id
    new_note = Note(id=next_id, **note.model_dump())
    next_id += 1
    notes.append(new_note)
    return new_note

steps.title: Get a single note
steps.description: Add a GET /notes/:id endpoint that returns a single note by its id. Return 404 if not found.
hints: Use .find() to locate the note, respond with 404 if missing

steps.title: Delete a note
